gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sansation: Commanding round forms lead here, Turret Road drawing each curve like an open parenthesis with a pen-like line behind it. Sansation follows quietly and approachably, which leaves the heading to do the loud work at big, short sizes.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sarabun: Chunky, confident, pen-drawn curves. Sarabun, a plain sans with a wide channel into every bowl, gives Turret Road's wire-thick strokes room to stand out.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sarala: Turret Road brings round, parenthesis-like forms and a bold pen line that feels sure of itself on arrival. Sarala follows with distinct gaps in its c, e and s, easy company over paragraphs.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Contemporary in feel, Sawarabi Gothic opens a jaw on every curved stroke, while Turret Road up top frames its counters with strokes of matching width. And over a longer stretch, the sans-serif body keeps its curves easy to follow.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shanti: Commanding is how Turret Road lands, with round forms and a flat, unmodulated pen line holding every headline together. Shanti then takes over with a generous entry into the e's eye, a modern sans that lets that heading speak first.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shippori-antique: Round, bold, a touch stubborn: Turret Road draws open-parenthesis curves in a constant pen-like line, while Shippori Antique keeps a monoweight skeleton below with bowls tipped open toward you. The heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shippori-antique-b: Round forms like open parentheses, drawn in one pen-like line, are what mark Turret Road out from the start. Shippori Antique B1 is a plain sans with daylight through every curved opening, so a long read stays modern and unfussy.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sn-pro: Commanding and bold, Turret Road swaps thin hairline joins for full-width stroke connections. SN Pro, a plain sans with open aperture curves throughout, gives that blunt heading a body that is simple to follow, and that clarity is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-snippet: Snippet reads approachably, its c like a crescent wrench opened wide and a wire-bent look running through each word. Turret Road sits above with bold, round, parenthesis-like forms, and the two share a drawn, constant-weight feel on the page.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sour-gummy: A drafting-pen outline quality, with one constant nib width, defines Turret Road's bold, round forms. And Sour Gummy's wide gaps keep tiny sizes crisp, so the sans-serif body stays sharp under that heading, which is the pair's real strength.
